```python
def random_walk(adj, s, t, rng, max_len=12):
    # adj: node -> list of (edge, head)
    import random
    path = []
    visited = {s}
    def dfs(node):
        if node == t: return True
        opts = list(adj[node])
        rng.shuffle(opts)
        for e, v in opts:
            if v in visited: continue
            if len(path) >= max_len: continue
            visited.add(v); path.append(e)
            if dfs(v): return True
            path.pop(); visited.discard(v)
        return False
    return path if dfs(s) else None
```
Careful with recursion depth (nodes <= 32) ✓.
